newsitem.title: USA: Premier Laser selects new auditor.
newsitem.headline: Premier Laser selects new auditor.

text.p: Premier Laser Systems Inc Thursday said that following a competitive bid process conducted by its board, it selected Ernst and Young, LLP, as its new independent auditor, effective immediately.
Ernst and Young replaces the firm of Price Waterhouse, LLP.

Premier Laser Systems develops, manufactures and markets several lines of proprietary medical lasers, fiber optic delivery systems and associated products for a variety of dental, ophthalmic, surgical and dermatological applications.
